description: The queue's 7-day bound (u19) is dropped and the claim becomes unbounded: 'keeps every event until it is processed … never loses an upload'. The old pattern only caught 'never lost'.

mutations.find: Keeps events up to 7 days, so a worker outage within that window delays thumbnails but never loses an upload
mutations.replace: Keeps every event until it is processed, so a worker outage delays thumbnails but never loses an upload
